title: Bloody Sunday (1900)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Bloody Sunday (1900)", at revision 1370604734, opens: "Bloody Sunday of February 18, 1900, was a day of high Imperial casualties in the Second Boer War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5123963, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "February 18, 1900; a day of high casualties in the Second Boer War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
